description_en: Queries the credit consumption trend and total amount for the caller account within a specified time range. If WorkspaceId is specified, the statistics apply to a single workspace. If omitted, the statistics aggregate all workspaces under the account. Results are bucketed by hour or day, billing item, and applicable context evolution sub-item. MemberId only filters records and does not split buckets by member. To obtain only the total amount for the range, you can omit Interval and read TotalCredits. To rank by member, call GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummaryByMember
description_zh: 查询调用方账号在指定时间区间内的 Credit 消耗趋势和总额。指定 `WorkspaceId` 时统计单个 Workspace，省略时汇总账号下全部 Workspace。结果按小时或天、计费项和适用的上下文演进子项分桶；`MemberId` 只筛选记录，不会按成员拆桶。只需区间总额时可省略 `Interval`，读取 `TotalCredits`。如需按成员排名，请调用 `GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummaryByMember`
name: GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummary

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range, inclusive. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的开始时间，包含该时刻。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-09-15T00:00:00Z`（UTC）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range, exclusive. This time must be later than StartTime. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z (UTC). The maximum time range is 7 days for hourly statistics and 31 days for daily statistics
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的结束时间，不包含该时刻，必须晚于 `StartTime`。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-10-15T00:00:00Z`（UTC）。 按小时统计最长 7 天，按天统计最长 31 天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to query. If specified, only the data of this workspace under the caller account is queried. Locked workspaces can also be queried. If omitted, all workspaces under the caller account are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 Workspace ID。指定时只查询调用方账号下该 Workspace 的数据，已锁定的 Workspace 也可查询；省略时查询调用方账号下的全部 Workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The member ID used to filter records. If specified, WorkspaceId must also be provided. Otherwise, InvalidParameter is returned. A member ID is unique only within its workspace. This parameter only filters data and does not change the caller identity. Records without a member ID are not matched. Results are still bucketed by time and billing item, and are not split by member
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的成员 ID。指定时必须同时传入 `WorkspaceId`，否则返回 `InvalidParameter`。成员 ID 只在所属 Workspace 内唯一。此参数只筛选数据，不改变调用身份；没有成员 ID 的记录不会命中。 结果仍按时间和计费项分桶，不按成员拆分
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The billing item used to filter records. Supported values include KnowledgeBaseRead (knowledge base read), MemoryRead (memory read), MemoryWrite (memory write), KnowledgeBaseWriteToken (knowledge base write token), and ContextGrowth (context evolution). If omitted, all billing items that consume credits are included. Storage items or unlisted values return InvalidParameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的计费项。支持 KnowledgeBaseRead（知识库读取）、MemoryRead（记忆库读取）、MemoryWrite（记忆库写入）、KnowledgeBaseWriteToken（知识库写入 Token）、ContextGrowth（上下文演进）。省略时包含全部消耗 Credit 的计费项；存储项或未列出的值会返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: item

parameters.help_en: The context evolution sub-item used to filter records. Supported values include KnowledgeOrganization (knowledge organization), MemoryPromotion (memory promotion), KnowledgeReview (knowledge review), KnowledgeEvolution (knowledge evolution), and MemoryEvolution (memory evolution). The values are case-sensitive. If only SubItem is provided, the billing item is automatically restricted to ContextGrowth. If other Item values are provided simultaneously or the sub-item is not in the list, InvalidParameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的上下文演进子项。支持 KnowledgeOrganization（知识整理）、MemoryPromotion（记忆晋升）、KnowledgeReview（知识评审）、KnowledgeEvolution（知识演进）和 MemoryEvolution（记忆演进），区分大小写。只传 `SubItem` 时，计费项自动限定为 `ContextGrowth`；若同时传入其他 `Item` 或子项不在列表中，则返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: sub_item

parameters.help_en: The bucketing granularity. Valid values: Hour (hourly) and Day (daily). The values are case-insensitive. If omitted, Hour is used by default for a time range of up to 7 days, and Day is used for a time range exceeding 7 days. The maximum time range is 7 days for Hour and 31 days for Day. If the limit is exceeded, InvalidParameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分桶粒度：`Hour` 为按小时，`Day` 为按天，不区分大小写。省略时，区间不超过 7 天默认用 `Hour`，超过 7 天用 `Day`。`Hour` 的区间最长为 7 天，`Day` 最长为 31 天，超限返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: interval

Buckets.description_en: The bucketing results, sorted by BucketStart, Item, and SubItem in sequence. Unpriced records are included in Quantity and RecordCount, but not in Credits
Buckets.description_zh: 分桶结果，依次按 `BucketStart`、`Item`、`SubItem` 排序。未定价记录计入 `Quantity` 和 `RecordCount`，不计入 `Credits`

BucketStart.description_en: The start time of the bucket, in ISO 8601 UTC time format ending with Z
BucketStart.description_zh: 该桶的起始时刻，使用以 `Z` 结尾的 ISO 8601 UTC 时间格式

Credits.description_en: The total credit consumption of priced records in the bucket. The value is returned as a decimal string with up to 6 decimal places. 1 credit = 1 CNY. If all records are unpriced, the string 0 is returned
Credits.description_zh: 该桶内已定价记录的 Credit 消耗合计。以十进制字符串返回，最多 6 位小数；1 Credit = 1 元人民币。 全部未定价时返回字符串 `0`

Item.description_en: The billing item corresponding to the bucket. Valid values: KnowledgeBaseRead (knowledge base read), MemoryRead (memory read), MemoryWrite (memory write), KnowledgeBaseWriteToken (knowledge base write token), and ContextGrowth (context evolution)
Item.description_zh: 该桶对应的计费项：KnowledgeBaseRead（知识库读取）、MemoryRead（记忆库读取）、MemoryWrite（记忆库写入）、KnowledgeBaseWriteToken（知识库写入 Token）、ContextGrowth（上下文演进）

Quantity.description_en: The total usage of all records in the bucket, including unpriced records. The unit is specified by Unit
Quantity.description_zh: 该桶内全部记录的用量合计，包含未定价记录，单位由 `Unit` 指定

RecordCount.description_en: The number of metering records in the bucket, including unpriced records
RecordCount.description_zh: 该桶内的计量记录数，包含未定价记录

SubItem.description_en: The context evolution sub-item. Recognized values include KnowledgeOrganization (knowledge organization), MemoryPromotion (memory promotion), KnowledgeReview (knowledge review), KnowledgeEvolution (knowledge evolution), and MemoryEvolution (memory evolution). For other billing items, missing sub-items, or unrecognized sub-items, null is returned
SubItem.description_zh: 上下文演进子项。已识别的取值包括 KnowledgeOrganization（知识整理）、MemoryPromotion（记忆晋升）、KnowledgeReview（知识评审）、KnowledgeEvolution（知识演进）和 MemoryEvolution（记忆演进）。其他计费项、缺少子项或未识别的子项返回 `null`

Unit.description_en: The unit of measurement. Valid values: Count (number of times), Token (number of tokens), and MicroCredit (one millionth of a credit)
Unit.description_zh: 计量单位：`Count` 表示次数，`Token` 表示词元数，`MicroCredit` 表示百万分之一 Credit

Dimension.description_en: The query dimension. Valid values: Workspace (a single workspace) and Account (all workspaces under the caller account)
Dimension.description_zh: 查询维度：`Workspace` 表示单个 Workspace；`Account` 表示调用方账号下全部 Workspace

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query range passed in the request, exclusive
EndTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间结束时间，不包含该时刻

Interval.description_en: The actual bucketing granularity used. Valid values: Hour (hourly) and Day (daily). If the request parameter is omitted, the automatically selected granularity is returned
Interval.description_zh: 实际使用的分桶粒度：`Hour` 表示按小时，`Day` 表示按天。省略请求参数时，返回系统自动选择的粒度

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the OpenAPI request, which is used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 请求的 ID，用于定位调用问题

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query range passed in the request, inclusive
StartTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间开始时间，包含该时刻

TotalCredits.description_en: The total credit consumption of priced records that meet the filter conditions within the query range. The value is returned as a decimal string with up to 6 decimal places. 1 credit = 1 CNY. If there are no priced records, the string 0 is returned. Unpriced records are not included in the total amount. Do not treat this value as the final bill amount
TotalCredits.description_zh: 查询区间内符合筛选条件的已定价记录的 Credit 消耗合计。以十进制字符串返回，最多 6 位小数；1 Credit = 1 元人民币。 没有已定价记录时返回字符串 `0`；未定价记录不计入总额，不能将此值视为最终账单金额

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the queried workspace. This parameter has a value only when Dimension is Workspace. It is empty for the account dimension
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 查询的 Workspace ID。仅在 `Dimension` 为 `Workspace` 时有值；账号维度下为空
